subject: I still do
author: jwillisjr
body:
I still play it. I like to go onto I-88 and showtime all around the lap if possible against oncoming traffic, then switch to the right side, then back to oncoming. It is still very fun to do, yet I have not done that since i was playing online and wanted to freak some people out in a race.

 

"The sleep of reason produces monsters" -Goya
